en: An average cumulus cloud weighs about 1.1 million pounds, which is roughly equal to the weight of 100 elephants.
It takes nature approximately 500 years to naturally produce just one single inch of fertile topsoil.
Pumice is the only rock that naturally floats on water because it is full of trapped volcanic gas bubbles.
Groundwater makes up about 30 percent of all freshwater on Earth, while lakes and rivers hold less than one percent.
A single day on Venus takes longer to complete than an entire year on Venus because it rotates so slowly.
A single teaspoon of a neutron star's incredibly dense material would weigh about six billion tons on Earth.
The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth at a rate of about 3.8 centimeters every single year.
The 1883 eruption of Mount Krakatoa created a sound so loud it ruptured the eardrums of sailors 40 miles away.
Diamonds and the graphite in your pencil are both made of pure carbon, just arranged in completely different structures.
The coldest air temperature ever recorded on Earth was minus 128.6 degrees Fahrenheit in Antarctica.
The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of Earth's oceans, reaching nearly 36,000 feet below sea level.
Sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel through the vacuum of space to reach Earth.
